title: Returned-Payment Points against Stop Relief — RentGuard Renters Policy
content:
Stop dishonour points: on the RentGuard Renters Policy, payments returned unpaid by the bank in the last 12 calendar months cost points against the stop relief on the charge owed when the multi-policy discount stops.

**Rule.** When two or more renters payments were returned unpaid in the last 12 calendar months, 20 points are subtracted from the stop relief; when exactly one renters payment was returned unpaid in the last 12 calendar months, 10 points are subtracted; when none was returned, none are subtracted.

| Renters payments returned unpaid, last 12 calendar months | Points subtracted from the stop relief |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 20 |
| Exactly 1 | 10 |
| None | 0 |

**Reading the records.** Each returned payment appears on the renters premium account as a payment returned entry, dated when it was posted; the count takes those posted within the last 12 calendar months. A return posted earlier than that window does not count.

**Hypothetical illustration.** Returns posted 3 months and 14 months ago: one falls inside the 12 calendar months, so 10 points are subtracted. Two returns posted 2 and 5 months ago: 20 points are subtracted.
